title: Vintage Rare ELVIS Presley MUG Coffee Cup Tennessee Memphis Gift Creation
descriptionText:
Basically brand new.

Add a touch of vintage to your collection with this rare Elvis Presley mug from Gift Creations. This coffee cup features a unique galaxy pattern and is made of high-quality ceramic and porcelain materials. The white color and original design make it a perfect addition to any Elvis-themed collection.

This coffee mug is a must-have for any Elvis fan and was manufactured in 1998 to celebrate his legacy. The set includes one coffee cup, and it is an original licensed reproduction. Perfect for memorabilia collectors or as a gift for a loved one, this vintage mug is a rare find that will surely be a prized possession for years to come.
